Z.notes: Captures the mature middle-aged professor brief best and locks non-face torso/star pixels cleanly across all 5 expressions, but clearly comes from a different pixel-art hand (sameArtist: false). Outline colour/weight: dual 1px dark outlines (#1d0e0d hair/face, #0f1330 coat), except the right sleeve border is un-outlined white #f3f5f4 at (62, 61..63). Palette and shading: 15-16 colours with very clean geometric clusters and a crisp chest star (41..47, 56..61), but sleeve folds are drawn as rigid 1px #97a1b0 lines (x=15..16 and 47..48, y=51..63) and grey hair temples use neutral #bebebe slabs. Eye and mouth construction: starkest style divergence — only 2 iris tones (#0f1330 + flat 4x2 #2f467e block) with pure #f3f5f4 sclera and no sclera corner AA (every cast member uses 3+ iris tones), prominent 3px nasolabial fold wrinkles at (25..26, 40..42) and (37..38, 40..42) absent across the entire cast, a stiff 4px vertical 1px nose bar (32, 35..38), and gag-style glintless bug-eyes in surprised. Framing and head size: top y=3, head_w=48, jaw_w=32 at y=36 match cast framing well.
